notes.title: 1/31/24 Patch Notes And Content Update
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Raised Playable Characters overall sensitivity from .4 to .5
[*] Added notes/ hints around the map to offer help for anyone struggling
[*] Opened up the secret Sub-Basement as a new  playable area, with an additional task for an alternate ending screen
[*] With level-transition implemented possibilities for future maps are now being thought up
[/list]

notes.title: Update Notes for 1/22/24
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Added 'Master Volume' slider
[*] Lowered Playable characters overall sensitivty to .4 from 1.0
[*] Cleared unnecessary lights, and obstructions to help reduce FPS drop
[*] Removed Motion Blur from the game (may add an option for those who want it later)
[*] Closed off sub-basement as it is now "Under Construction" more on that soon.
[*] Also congrats to Ziggy The Adventurer for finding both Easter egg locations!
[/list]
